summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Precision Drilling Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the voting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on May 14, 2026. The filing discloses that shareholders approved the election of all eight director nominees and passed all other items, including the advisory vote on executive compensation. This is a routine disclosure of annual meeting outcomes, not a special situation. The filing does not involve any transaction, strategic change, or extraordinary corporate event.
